[adapters]
  --- adapters.directory: string
[auth]
  -SX auth.tokens: array
[benchmarks]
  --- benchmarks.long_context_max_tokens: integer 1000 … 2000000
  --- benchmarks.max_fit_context_tokens: integer 8192 … 2000000
[calibration]
  --- calibration.holdout_fraction: number 0 … 1
  --- calibration.min_agreement: number -1 … 1
  --- calibration.min_samples: integer ≥ 1
  --- calibration.n_holdout_target: integer ≥ 1
  --- calibration.partition_seed: integer
  --- calibration.target_samples: integer ≥ 1
[console]
  --- console.url: string
[evidence]
  --- evidence.capability_weights_path: string
  --- evidence.freshness_floor: number 0 … 1
  --- evidence.goal_contribution_weight: number ≥ 0
  --- evidence.n_target: integer ≥ 1
  --- evidence.name_only_identity_factor: number 0 … 1
  --- evidence.performance_drift_factor: number 0 … 1
  --- evidence.performance_half_life_days: number ≥ 0
  --- evidence.quality_drift_factor: number 0 … 1
  --- evidence.quality_half_life_days: number ≥ 0
  --- evidence.stale_below: number 0 … 1
[execution]
  L-- execution.cooldown_seconds: number 0 … 600
  --- execution.gpu_index: integer ≥ 0
  L-- execution.idle_gpu_threshold_percent: number 0 … 100
  --- execution.idle_required_samples: integer ≥ 1
  --- execution.idle_wait_timeout_seconds: number ≥ 0
  L-- execution.measured_repetitions: integer 1 … 50
  L-- execution.on_idle_timeout: string {warn,refuse}
  L-- execution.randomize_case_order: boolean
  --- execution.run_timeout_seconds: number ≥ 0
  L-- execution.seed: integer 0 … 2147483647
  --- execution.store_responses: boolean
  --- execution.test_timeout_seconds: number ≥ 0
  L-- execution.warmup_repetitions: integer 0 … 20
[external]
  --- external.download_cap_bytes: integer ≥ 0
  --- external.install_timeout_seconds: integer ≥ 1
  -S- external.root: string
[goals]
  --- goals.max_pack_bytes: integer ≥ 0
  -S- goals.root: string
  --- goals.rule_timeout_ms: integer ≥ 0
[judge]
  -S- judge.allow_remote: boolean
  --- judge.blind_candidate_identity: boolean
  --- judge.jury_size: integer ≥ 1
  --- judge.max_output_tokens: integer ≥ 1
  --- judge.models: array
  --- judge.randomize_order: boolean
  --- judge.refuse_self_judging: boolean
  --- judge.repetitions: integer ≥ 1
  --- judge.temperature: number 0 … 2
[logging]
  --- logging.format: string {text,json,auto}
  -S- logging.include_content: boolean
  L-- logging.level: string
[provider]
  -S- provider.active: string
  -S- provider.base_url: string
  --- provider.kind: string

  --- provider.memory_max_bytes: integer ≥ 1

  --- provider.state_dir: string
  --- provider.timeout_seconds: number ≥ 0
[providers]
  -S- providers.allow_remote: boolean
[runtime]
  --- runtime.batch_size: integer ≥ 0
  --- runtime.context_size: integer ≥ 0
  --- runtime.fit_to_device: boolean
  --- runtime.flash_attention: boolean
  --- runtime.gpu_layers: integer ≥ 0
  --- runtime.keep_alive: string
  --- runtime.kv_cache_precision: string {f16,q8_0,q4_0}

[sandbox]
  --- sandbox.cpu_limit: integer 1 … 256
  --- sandbox.memory_limit_mb: integer ≥ 64
  -S- sandbox.tier: string {auto,container,bwrap,none}
  --- sandbox.timeout_seconds: integer ≥ 1
[server]
  -S- server.allow_lan_exposure: boolean
  -S- server.allowed_hosts: array
  -S- server.host: string
  -S- server.port: integer 1 … 65535
  --- server.request_timeout_seconds: number ≥ 0
[storage]
  -S- storage.artifact_dir: string
  --- storage.auto_migrate: boolean

  -S- storage.database_url: string
  --- storage.statement_timeout_ms: integer ≥ 0
[telemetry]
  L-- telemetry.calibrate_overhead: boolean
  L-- telemetry.interval_ms: integer 100 … 60000
